---
title: "05 MICE Imputation"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(mice)

options(scipen = 999)

# Final MICE imputation run for baseline propensity-score covariates.
# No clipping, truncation, or rounding is performed.

INPUT_PATH <- here("data", "derived", "ipw_wide.rds")
OUTPUT_DIR <- here("data", "derived")

M <- 20L
MAXIT <- 20L
SEED <- 424

stopifnot(file.exists(INPUT_PATH))

dat_raw <- readRDS(INPUT_PATH)

cat("Input dimensions:", nrow(dat_raw), "x", ncol(dat_raw), "\n")
cat("Unique couples:", n_distinct(dat_raw$couple_id), "\n")

stopifnot(
  nrow(dat_raw) == 1602,
  n_distinct(dat_raw$couple_id) == 1602
)
```

## 1. Pre-imputation missingness

```{r}
missingness <- tibble(
  variable = names(dat_raw),
  n_missing = map_int(dat_raw, ~ sum(is.na(.x)))
) %>%
  filter(n_missing > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_missing))

print(missingness)

expected_incomplete <- c(
  "hinc",
  "hgowner",
  "smallspace",
  "livedhere",
  "east",
  "M_edu_level",
  "F_edu_level"
)

unexpected_incomplete <- setdiff(
  missingness$variable,
  expected_incomplete
)

if (length(unexpected_incomplete) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Unexpected incomplete variables: ",
    paste(unexpected_incomplete, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

missing_expected_but_absent <- setdiff(
  expected_incomplete,
  missingness$variable
)

if (length(missing_expected_but_absent) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Expected incomplete variables are no longer missing: ",
    paste(missing_expected_but_absent, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

cat("PASS: missingness occurs only in the expected variables.\n")
```

## 2. Prepare variable types

```{r}
dat <- dat_raw %>%
  mutate(
    hgowner = factor(hgowner, levels = c(0, 1)),
    smallspace = factor(smallspace, levels = c(0, 1)),
    east = factor(east, levels = c(0, 1)),
    M_employment = factor(M_employment, levels = 1:4),
    F_employment = factor(F_employment, levels = 1:4),
    M_edu_level = ordered(M_edu_level, levels = 1:4),
    F_edu_level = ordered(F_edu_level, levels = 1:4)
  )
```

## 3. Create MICE method vector and predictor matrix

```{r}
meth <- make.method(dat)
pred <- make.predictorMatrix(dat)
```

## 4. Specify imputation methods

```{r}
meth[] <- ""

meth["hinc"]      <- "pmm"
meth["livedhere"] <- "pmm"

meth["hgowner"]    <- "logreg"
meth["smallspace"] <- "logreg"
meth["east"]       <- "logreg"

meth["M_edu_level"] <- "polr"
meth["F_edu_level"] <- "polr"

method_table <- tibble(
  variable = names(meth),
  method = unname(meth)
) %>%
  filter(method != "")

print(method_table)

stopifnot(
  setequal(
    names(meth)[meth != ""],
    expected_incomplete
  )
)
```

## 5. Predictor matrix

```{r}
pred[,] <- 1
diag(pred) <- 0

# couple_id is an identifier only and is never used as a predictor.
pred[, "couple_id"] <- 0
pred["couple_id", ] <- 0

# Complete variables may predict missing covariates but are not imputed.
not_imputed <- names(meth)[meth == ""]
pred[not_imputed, ] <- 0

target_vars <- names(meth)[meth != ""]

print(
  pred[
    target_vars,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)

stopifnot(
  all(pred[, "couple_id"] == 0),
  all(pred["couple_id", ] == 0)
)
```

## 6. Run final MICE imputation

```{r}
imp <- mice(
  dat,
  m = M,
  maxit = MAXIT,
  method = meth,
  predictorMatrix = pred,
  printFlag = TRUE,
  seed = SEED,
  polr.to.loggedEvents = TRUE
)

print(imp)
```

## 7. Logged events

```{r}
if (is.null(imp$loggedEvents)) {
  cat("No logged events.\n")
} else {
  print(imp$loggedEvents)
}
```

## 8. Save final imputation objects

```{r}
dir.create(
  OUTPUT_DIR,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  dat,
  here("data", "derived", "mice_input_final.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  imp,
  here("data", "derived", "mice_imp_final.rds")
)

completed_long <- complete(
  imp,
  action = "long",
  include = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  completed_long,
  here("data", "derived", "mice_completed_long_final.rds")
)
```

## 9. Immediate support checks

```{r}
support_check <- completed_long %>%
  summarise(
    min_hinc = min(hinc, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_hinc = max(hinc, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nonpositive_hinc = sum(hinc <= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_livedhere = min(livedhere, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_livedhere = max(livedhere, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_negative_livedhere = sum(livedhere < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_noninteger_livedhere = sum(
      abs(livedhere - round(livedhere)) > 1e-8,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

print(support_check)

stopifnot(
  support_check$n_nonpositive_hinc == 0,
  support_check$n_negative_livedhere == 0,
  support_check$n_noninteger_livedhere == 0
)
```

## 10. Final summary

```{r}
n_logged <- if (
  is.null(imp$loggedEvents)
) {
  0L
} else {
  nrow(imp$loggedEvents)
}

cat("\n====================================\n")
cat("05 FINAL MICE IMPUTATION SUMMARY\n")
cat("====================================\n")
cat("Couples:", nrow(dat), "\n")
cat("Imputations:", imp$m, "\n")
cat("Iterations:", imp$iteration, "\n")
cat("Seed:", SEED, "\n")
cat("Logged events:", n_logged, "\n")
cat("Minimum hinc:", min(completed_long$hinc, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat(
  "Negative livedhere:",
  sum(completed_long$livedhere < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Noninteger livedhere:",
  sum(
    abs(completed_long$livedhere - round(completed_long$livedhere)) > 1e-8,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  "\n"
)
cat("====================================\n")
```
